html2pdf.js bundled license notice

The vendored `html2pdf.bundle.min.js` file references this companion notice file.
The bundle is used locally for offline PDF export support.

Known bundled components from the bundle contents and upstream package:

- html2pdf.js: MIT
- jsPDF: MIT
- html2canvas: MIT
- core-js-pure and Babel runtime helpers: MIT

Before replacing this bundle, regenerate the upstream license notice file from
the exact package build and update `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` with the new
version, component list, and SHA-256 hash.
